en: Colorized vintage view over rooftops toward a busy harbor with sailing ships and steamers. In the foreground stands a church with a tall pointed steeple among dense urban buildings. Across the water is a tree‑covered promontory with large monumental buildings. The lower front margin contains printed French text identifying the scene, a series number, publisher information, and handwritten inscriptions and date.
